method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: Accept num with no explicit receiver requirement. Coerce num through int first. If level.createfxexploders and its num entry are both defined, iterate i from 0 while i is less than the current entry size and invoke activate_individual_exploder synchronously on each indexed entry. The lightning predicate is evaluated independently after that loop, including when the array guard fails. Only a truthy exploder_is_lightning_exploder(num) plus both defined lightning pointers starts a new fx::lightning thread with those two pointers as arguments. No payload is returned. Definition tests do not establish valid arrays, callable pointer types, index bounds, native int conversion or actual FX delivery.
